A Letter for Aparna

♡   With love   ♡

Dear Aparna ❤️,

I hope today reminds you of just how special you are. Thank you for being exactly who you are. May this new chapter of your life bring you happiness, and countless reasons to smile. I want you to know that I'll always be there for you, for as long as you want me to be. You are my first, and I wish with all my heart that you'll be my last. But at the end of the day, it's your all about you, and I will always respect whatever you choose. Thank you for standing by me through all the tough times and for being a part of my life. I'll always be grateful for that. Wishing you the happiest birthday, my ❤️

With lots of love,
Akshayyyy 💗
